'''Ryll Narbe''' was an employee of the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. He was based in a research outpost in [[Edic Bar]] on [[Genarius]] and he designed the [[G61 Delta Wing]], to prove to the Corporation that he was still a credible designer.
